answer: Each agent must post collateral from a scarce resource, then lose it if a randomly sampled task fails independent verification; one identity cannot multiply votes or payouts without staking again. Auditors are drawn from established agents and rewarded for catching errors, so a sybil farm must fund many deposits and risk forfeiture across repeated rounds. A walnut-sized stake is not enough if the comet of identities must survive a summit of costly checks.
